rundown: Dempo SC beat Lajong 2-1 at Pandit Jawaharlal Nehru Stadium in Fatorda, Goa. Dempo SC led 2-1 at half-time and held on.
Goals: Lajong Damaitphang Lyngdoh 41'; Dempo SC Cledson Carvalho Da Silva 16', Laximanrao Rane 45'+1'.

review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 19, 5:29 AM ET. It had Lajong 45%, the draw 29% and Dempo SC 26%, projecting Lajong 1.4 – Dempo SC 1 (2.4 total, Lajong by 0.4).

Final: Lajong 1 – Dempo SC 2. Wrong winner: it had Lajong at 45%, and Dempo SC (26%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Lajong came in with a 21% above average attack and a 25% stingier than average defense (2-1-0, 1.3 scored and 0.7 allowed a game over 3 games), worth about 23 and 22 games of evidence. Projected to score 1.4, they scored 1 (−0.4 goals, 29% under); projected to allow 1, they allowed 2 (+1 goals, 96% over).

Dempo SC came in with a 8% below average attack and a 7% stingier than average defense (2-0-1, 1.3 scored and 1 allowed a game over 3 games), worth about 23 and 22 games of evidence. Projected to score 1, they scored 2 (+1 goals, 96% over); projected to allow 1.4, they allowed 1 (−0.4 goals, 29% under).

The bigger miss was Dempo SC's scoring (+1 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 3 against 2.4 projected (+0.6), about the 63rd percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±1.7).

Margin: Dempo SC by 1 against Lajong by 0.4 projected, about the 80th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±1.7).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.title: Situational factors, checked
review.body: Nothing situational moved this projection (rest, travel, form and conditions were all normal), so it came down to team strength.

review.title: Against the market
review.body: No line was priced for this game (no posted odds, or not enough data to price one).

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; inputs were missing (SHL lineup rating or past seasons, DSC lineup rating or past seasons); there were no odds to check the projection against.

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×1.137 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by +1.3 goals. It counts toward Soccer scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 1327 graded Soccer games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams -0.1 goals. Team corrections so far: Dempo SC attack ×1.040, defense ×1.006 (5 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
